name: Bench Notes
rationale: The content is a working lab notebook for agent engineering, so the theme pairs a warm paper-and-ink base with a deep teal and a restrained amber accent — like a lab bench with instrument panels. A serif body keeps evergreen notes readable and scholarly, while monospace is reserved for code, evals, and spec-like labels, reinforcing the building/evaluating/securing triad without gimmicks.
tagline: Notes on designing, measuring, and hardening LLM agents — a self-growing knowledge base.
